verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a catalog of models on its public endpoints and a guide for choosing among open-source models (cerebras-docs-21, cerebras-docs-18, cerebras-docs-11). The only model concretely evidenced on the public shared tier is qwen-3.8-27b (cerebras-docs-29), which a community user corroborates (cerebras-comm-1). missing for 10: evidence that Llama, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS or other peer families are actually offered on shared endpoints, an enumerated model list showing catalog breadth, and independent confirmation of multi-family choice.
